rows.notes: The cited document is explicitly a narrative review (title and section headings: 'Review'; Section 4 'In this review, we began by describing...'). It reports no own data, experiment, survey or model runs; it summarises other studies on drone/remote sensing detection of plant diseases (e.g. rice sheath blight, potato late blight, HLB citrus). Even the reviewed content concerns disease detection and monitoring rather than pest control, and nothing concerns organic systems; the claim that drones and remote sensing enhance pest control rests at most on a precondition (detection/monitoring) and is not an own result of this document. Because Q1 is 'no', all other questions are 'no'.

notes: Document is a review article in Agronomy (MDPI, 2023), with some duplicated page layout text but complete. No primary data reported.
